faction.tartarus-town.tartarus.descripti: Tartarus is the name given to the two polar regions of the Kreegan Plane; the native inhabitants call their region Freegan. These demons, who once lived in the polar regions, were also suppressed by the Inferno forces, but after the Inferno forces moved to Eeofol, they quickly became the de facto rulers of the Kreegan Plane. Taking advantage of the defeat of the Inferno forces, they moved from Kreegan to Antagraich.
faction.tartarus-town.tartarus.name: Tartarus
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero01.biography: Young, by the standards of freegan, demon Tarox has a very carefree disposition. First of all, he cares about his own prosperity and idle pleasures. It is not surprising that the small younger demons are drawn to Tarox and form his main retinue.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero01.name: Tarox
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero01.specialty.d: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Ice Spawns or Quasits he commands for each level attainded after 1st level.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero02.biography: Breldzur is one of the most respected freegans. He is famous for the fact that he is able to make a work of art from the most unsightly ice. Even fellow Krigans admire Breldzur's talent. In war, this demon has a huge amount of working material, so that he can do what he loves without stopping.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero02.name: Breldzur
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero02.specialty.d: Cast an extra basic demonic blood at the beginning of battle.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero03.biography: The Gelugons have a very strict internal hierarchy. Nzistov was the oldest gelugon, who, among other things, had great magical power. Therefore, he was able to become the most important among these insect-like demons. The Gelugons under the command of Nzistov fight tirelessly to earn respect in the eyes of the elder.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero03.name: Nzistov
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero03.specialty.d: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Gelugons or Supreme Gelugons he commands for each level attainded after 6th level.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero04.biography: Among freegans, Gernax was known as not a very smart leader, but many demons respect him for his impressive size and sense of humor (of course, understandable only to other freegans). On the battlefield, the unusual behavior of Gernax and the huge size of this demon demoralize opponents.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero04.name: Gernax
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero05.biography: Allar was a very cunning and greedy magician. He was expelled in disgrace from Bracada when they learned that he was plotting against Gavin Magnus himself. Allar was not confused and believed that the Freegans could become excellent allies in his campaign for power and wealth.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero05.name: Allar
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero05.specialty.d: Provide 1 mercury per day to your kingdom.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero06.biography: The brave northern warrior Tasabu once sent his troops to storm the Freegan citadels. As a result, his army was defeated, and the barbarian himself was captured. The demons processed Tasab's mind a bit and since then he has served them faithfully, helping them fight in unusual conditions for freegans.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero06.name: Tasabu
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero06.specialty.d: Give 5% extra bonus per level to Logistics skill.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero07.biography: It is said that once it was an elf thief. But now it is a unique intelligent ice golem obtained during a magical experiment. Coldron is able to speak and make decisions on his own, but he remembers nothing about his past life and is therefore immensely devoted to freegans.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero07.name: Coldron
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero07.specialty.d: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Ice Golems or Frost Golems he commands for each level attainded after 2th level.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero08.biography: Shagreksa is proud of her invention. She learned how to make ice shells for ballistas that explode on impact. The rest of the freegans underestimate her branded weapons, but Shagreksa thinks otherwise, since she herself tested the ice ballista on Erathian soldiers and was satisfied with her offspring.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero08.name: Shagreksa
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero08.specialty.d: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of Ballista for each level attainded after 4th level.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero09.biography: Erica never suppose she has the relevance of any demons. However, she chased a powerful demon and follow him to a deeper cave during her adventure process. Finally she eliminated the demon but she was attracted by frozen atmosphere. Now she don't think she can leave the abyss any longer.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero09.name: Erica
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero09.specialty.d: Casts Ice Bolt with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater when used on weaker units.).
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero10.biography: One of the first freegans to find and tame ice demons was Raldaxa. She alone knows where the demons found such creatures. Raldaxa has studied these creatures very well and is able to motivate them better than other freegans. She also wrote an extensive work on the selection of ice demons and their relationship with other species, which she is very proud of.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero10.name: Raldaxa
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero10.specialty.d: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Frost Creepers or Frost Horrors she commands for each level attainded after 4th level.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero11.biography: Among the furies, few people are able to master the art of the navigator. But Moridda is an exception. Breldzur himself noticed the gift of furies and advised her to seriously engage in this craft. Now Moridda is one of the most respected furies and more or less a good developer. Other furies envy her, but do not risk saying it - do not want to become a new icy masterpiece.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero11.name: Moridda
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero11.specialty.d: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Furies or Stygain Furies she commands for each level attainded after 3th level.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero12.biography: Atianna hates her sister Moridda with all her heart. After all, her sister took her place as the leader of the furies. Now Atianna is forced to put up with the position of Moridda's right hand and hatch a plan for revenge. Although she is not as skillful a warrior as her sister, she knows a lot about tactics and has an impressive supply of jewelry that she uses for bribery.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero12.name: Atianna
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero12.specialty.d: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Arachnes or Crystal Arachnes she commands for each level attainded after 5th level.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero13.biography: The real name of this freeman is already firmly forgotten. Blizzard was not a very strong physical demon, but all her offenders very quickly turned into ice statues from one touch. For this she received her nickname. Now Blizzard enchants the weapons of her warriors, so that they also turn into ice opponents of freegans.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero13.name: Blizzard
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero13.specialty.d: Casts Ice Meteor with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater when used on weaker units).
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero14.biography: Knowing the weaknesses of the enemy and striking at the most unexpected moments is Drazz's favorite tactic. He is one of the smartest demons who thinks it is unwise to lose warriors where it can be avoided. Drazz has a lot of enemies among the generals who have ever resisted him and managed to survive. They find his tactics dirty.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero14.name: Drazz
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero14.specialty.d: Give 5% extra bonus per level to Intelligence skill.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero15.biography: Many women are primarily concerned with how to preserve their beauty. The young sorceress Iollona also once asked this question. The girl found a way to keep her body young with the help of cold, but something messed up with charms and now can not live long without a low temperature. For decades of loneliness in the ice cave, Iolona's mind was completely clouded and she decided to take revenge on all mankind by joining her 'brothers' freegans.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero15.name: Iollona
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero15.specialty.d: Give 5% extra bonus per level to Resistance skill.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero16.biography: Krigans love experiments. In Sixiasil combined two incompatible magical powers - earth and air. Surprisingly, she survived, although she complains that she is sometimes torn apart. In addition, Sixiasil has gained the ability to suck magic out of anything - she needs a regular influx of mana so that the forces do not break her.
hero.tartarus-town.tarhero16.name: Sixiasil

mapObject.tartarus-town.creatureBank.ftf:
{Bloody Tower}

The eerie laughter of succubuses echoes from the bizarrely shaped tower, and any passerby who stumbles in becomes their prey. You know they enjoy using blood as sacrifices in their wicked rituals. Now is your chance to rid the people of this menace. Will you destroy these evil succubuses?

{Bloody Tower}

The bizarrely shaped tower was eerily quiet. As you entered, only dried bloodstains told you that this had once been a den of evil. But thankfully, brave warriors had vanquished the evil, and you couldn't help but admire their righteous deeds.
